description: System health auditing capability handling database optimization, vector store integrity checks, resource guarding, telemetry gathering, and automated skill gap resolution.
author: Charon Librarian

system_sys_optimize.description: Runs SQLite PRAGMA and VACUUM optimizations on target databases.

target_db.description: Optional explicit path or directory to target for database optimization.

system_sys_audit.description: Audits process memory, disk utilization, GPU usage, and verifies system limits for LLM execution.

system_sys_get.description: Gathers host telemetry, CPU/RAM utilization, and system database file sizes.

system_sys_resolve.description: Sweeps for open skill gaps, notifies the IPC daemon, and triggers charon-forge automated scaffolding.
